summary: Sepsis under a trend/severity transition encoding is a verified PURE-PRESENCE dataset. Which deterioration transitions occur carries the signal; multiplicity and order do not, even on this slow physiological deterioration.
encoding: direction-of-change (rising/falling run onsets, 6h lookback, 0.5*IQR) + severity-band entry (abnormal/severe) transition events, 12 channels; outcome=first SepsisLabel==1 hour (challenge built-in 6h lead).
confound_control: Static threshold encoding failed length-matching (signal was window truncation from early-onset patients). Trend encoding re-tested on length-matched windows (exactly K events, count AUROC=0.500 by construction).
conclusion: Presence is a genuine, robust channel (survives length matching, min 0.54 > 0.50 in every split); multiplicity is null and not robust; order is negative in all splits. Slow physiological deterioration sits in the SAME pure-presence regime as the two wind-farm co-located bursts. Across all seven datasets, presence is the universal channel and order essentially never carries usable signal.
